note_en: Chinese often names an effect first and then explains it with 这也是为什么… "this is also why...": 这也是为什么每年春节前后会出现大规模的"春运". Another handy frame is 关键在于… "the key lies in...": 要真正缩小城乡差距，关键在于让农村人口享有…同等的发展机会. In both, the opening clause sets up the topic and the second gives the point, much like English "That's why..." or "The key is..."
